    AI Overview
    Harry Diamond has been Rory McIlroy's full-time caddie since 2017, serving as a steadying, calm presence on the bag during numerous victories, including the 2025 Masters. A former top amateur golfer from Northern Ireland, Diamond is a childhood friend and confidant, often described by McIlroy as a "big brother" figure. 
    This video shows Rory McIlroy's emotional tribute to his caddie, Harry Diamond, after their Masters win:
    00:46
    Sky Sports Golf
    YouTube• Apr 14, 2025
    Key Facts About Harry Diamond 
    • Relationship: They met as young boys at Holywood Golf Club, and Diamond was best man at McIlroy’s 2017 wedding
      .
    • Background: A talented player in his own right, Diamond won the 2012 West of Ireland Championship.
    • Appointment: He replaced J.P. Fitzgerald as McIlroy's caddie in 2017.
    • Impact: Known for maintaining a calm demeanor and open communication, which helps McIlroy navigate high-stakes pressure. 
    Diamond has partnered with McIlroy for multiple, including the 2025 Masters, multiple FedEx Cups, and Ryder Cup successes. 
    In this video, McIlroy explains how the close, open, and honest relationship with his caddie leads to success:
